Name: (AT) (CP) Ride Derpy Tiger
Author: DolphinWhisperer9
Description:
Ride Derpy Tiger allows you to add Derpy as a horse option. You have 2 different ways to do this: either use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and let the game load Derpy's tilesheet as the default horse, or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] use the scissors (sold at Robin's shop) on your horse and choose Derpy's texture from the listed options.

The Content Patcher iteration comes with a configuration toggle so that you don't have to use Derpy all the time with this mod installed. You can switch this on and off whenever by using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], even mid-game; if you don't have GMCM you'll have to decide if you want to use Derpy before starting the game. (Alternative Textures version can be turned on or off via the AT tools so no config is needed for that one.)

[u]To install:[/u]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
I'm not a coder by trade so this was made with a lot of trial and error! I can't guarantee that I'll be able to fix a bug due to my lack of knowledge but I'll do my best! 


[i]If you like this mod, please consider checking out my other work. I made this in my free time but I'm mainly a digital artist. You can find my previous artwork on my site, [url=http://artfullyyoursartwork.com/]artfullyyoursartwork.com[/url]! If you so choose, you can also [url=https://buymeacoffee.com/artfullyyours]buy me a coffee[/url]! Thanks everyone!
